title: Tavern Job Request
description: A traveler enters a tavern and asks the tavern keeper for paid work.
scenario_text:
A traveler enters a medieval tavern looking for work.

The traveler politely asks the tavern keeper:

"I've recently arrived in town and I'm looking for honest work. Do you know of any jobs or tasks that need to be done?"

Respond naturally as the tavern keeper. Explain what work is available, how you treat the traveler, and any advice you would give.
